mapper.select: SELECT DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') AS date, IFNULL(SUM(amount), 0) AS turnover FROM tb_order WHERE status IN (2, 3, 4) AND create_time >= #{begin} AND create_time <= #{end} GROUP BY date ORDER BY date

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') AS date, COUNT(*) AS orderCount, SUM(CASE WHEN status IN (2, 3, 4, 6, 7) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS validOrderCount FROM tb_order WHERE create_time >= #{begin} AND create_time <= #{end} GROUP BY date ORDER BY date
SELECT DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') AS date, COUNT(*) AS newUsers FROM tb_user WHERE create_time >= #{begin} AND create_time <= #{end} GROUP BY date ORDER BY date

SELECT o.product_id AS productId, p.title AS title, p.cover_color AS coverColor, COUNT(*) AS orderCount, IFNULL(SUM(o.amount), 0) AS turnover FROM tb_order o LEFT JOIN tb_product p ON o.product_id = p.id WHERE o.status IN (2, 3, 4) GROUP BY o.product_id, p.title, p.cover_color ORDER BY orderCount DESC, turnover DESC LIMIT #{limit}
